title: Krull dimension of a finite type algebra over a field is preserved by field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] (a field $K$ with a ring homomorphism $k\to K$), and $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $K\otimes_kS$ be the tensor product, a $K$-algebra. Then the Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of the topological spaces $\operatorname{Spec}S$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] are equal: $\dim\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)=\dim\operatorname{Spec}S$ in $\{-\infty,0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00P3 (lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension, algebra.tex line 28290), where $\dim(S)$ is the Krull dimension of the ring $S$, i.e. of $\operatorname{Spec}S$; tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (00P3,algebra-lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension)

proof.text: Put $S_K=S\otimes_kK$ and let $\tau:S_K\xrightarrow{\sim}K\otimes_kS$ be the canonical symmetry isomorphism of tensor products. By [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], the map $S\to S_K$, $s\mapsto s\otimes1$, is faithfully flat. Transporting this map along $\tau$ gives the map $j:S\to K\otimes_kS$, $s\mapsto1\otimes s$, and faithful flatness is unchanged by the target ring isomorphism $\tau$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00P3 (lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension, line 28290), together with the field-extension flatness input used in its proof; tensor-factor symmetry is the canonical swap

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum], the faithfully flat map $j$ induces a surjection $\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)\to\operatorname{Spec}S$. Thus every prime of $S$ is the contraction of at least one prime of $K\otimes_kS$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00P3 (lemma-dimension-preserved-field-extension, line 28290), with the standard faithfully-flat lying-over consequence for the scalar-extension map

proof.text: For a prime $\mathfrak q_K\subset K\otimes_kS$ let $\mathfrak q=j^{-1}(\mathfrak q_K)$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-at-point-field-extension] to $S$ and $K/k$, whose tensor factor order is changed by the same symmetry $\tau$. The induced homeomorphism of affine spectra carries $\mathfrak q_K$ to the corresponding point in the $S\otimes_kK$ presentation, so the local-dimension equality from that lemma reads $\dim_{\mathfrak q_K}\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)=\dim_{\mathfrak q}\operatorname{Spec}S$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00P4 (lemma-dimension-at-a-point-preserved-field-extension, line 28307), applied to the primes over the scalar-extension map; the swap $S\otimes_kK\cong K\otimes_kS$ preserves prime chains and local dimensions

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-supremum-local-dimensions] for each affine spectrum. It gives $\dim\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)=\sup_{\mathfrak q_K}\dim_{\mathfrak q_K}\operatorname{Spec}(K\otimes_kS)$ and $\dim\operatorname{Spec}S=\sup_{\mathfrak q}\dim_{\mathfrak q}\operatorname{Spec}S$, with the empty-spectrum supremum equal to $-\infty$. By step 2, contraction $\mathfrak q_K\mapsto\mathfrak q$ has image all primes of $S$, and by step 3 the corresponding local dimensions are equal. Therefore the two suprema, and hence the two Krull dimensions, are equal.

The empty-spectrum case is covered by the -infinity convention in 0B7I.
